s00844.summary: Sunniva consults a remote doctor about Ibrahim's hand wound while he downplays it.
Low vitals and inconsistent answers lead Lakshmi to ask directly about painkillers.
Ibrahim admits he has taken the entire opioid stock since October and begs secrecy.

s02163.summary: Nurse Odette and wounded Captain Zelda share a cellar and four morphine ampoules.
Zelda refuses to talk about the dying girl or her own broken leg.
A shell lands close; Zelda notes it was friendly fire.
They share a bitter laugh and speak of family in Lyon and Leeds.
Odette offers her morphine; Zelda refuses, speaking of the girl and herself.
Boots strike the door above and Zelda reaches for her pistol.
Zelda recognizes an English voice and shouts that they are down here.
Rescuers approach; Odette puts the ampoule away and cries silently.

s02117.summary: Lawyer Rosalinda and client Ernestine exchange dry greetings across the glass.
Rosalinda relays a five-year plea offer; Ernestine refuses to admit taking money.
Rosalinda lays out what fifteen years means and Ernestine weighs her reputation.
Seeing Ernestine's dignity, Rosalinda agrees to take the case to trial.

s00370.summary: A family and teacher wait out the ice-bound winter aboard a barge.
Three knocks bring a hatless stranger across the rotten ice, and Halvard lets him in.
Oskar counts the crew; Toby mentions the dead deckhand Gunnar under the deck.
Oskar reveals no one is coming for the barge and offers passage for three.
Halvard blows out the lantern and insists Oskar leave alone; a knife leaves its sheath.

s01926.summary: Ruby and Domi tease each other in the 2 a.m. laundromat.
Cast-wearing Kwabena and prom-dressed Shoshana arrive bickering.
Domi learns Kwabena abandoned Shoshana at prom for a cast and confronts him.
Domi shoves Kwabena and the others scuffle until Ruby shouts them down.
A red sock rolls out of a dryer and they mumble apologies.

s01355.summary: A saloon crowd drinks in a storm while Mercedes watches Jed.
Mercedes names Jed as her brother's killer as he reaches for his gun.
Jed draws, Mercedes shoots first, and the bar dives for cover.
Mercedes stands over wounded Jed with the rifle at his chest.
The Reverend tends Jed; Mercedes lowers the rifle and walks out into the rain.

s02271.summary: Hollis, a former ferryman, watches the far bank as a widow approaches.
Perpetua opens a bag showing a revolver and says she wants a word with her husband's ferryman.
Hollis's brother Elias hails him from the far bank and warns him not to let her aboard.
Perpetua boards; they both draw and fire as the ferry breaks loose.

s02333.summary: Thieves Vesna and Dmitri drop into the cheese vault; Dmitri nearly drops a wheel.
They creep to the cabinet, dodging a camera sweep under Kofi's countdown.
Dmitri cracks the code, footsteps approach, and the cabinet holds a small gold-wrapped cheese.
Footsteps close in and the pair grab the cheese and bolt for the shaft.

s02258.summary: Coach Whitlock drills his players on a final-quarter comeback and reassures Ilya.
The buzzer sounds, the team huddles and files out; Whitlock mutters a plea.

s01283.summary: Reuben presses a wound in a pitching sick bay as Felix calls from the bridge.
Reuben demands a ventilator, learns port is eleven hours away, and asks Felix to pray.
He inserts a needle between the ribs and the sailor breathes.
Reuben slumps exhausted, contemplating the eleven hours, and tells Felix to keep her steady.

s02388.summary: A tense Thanksgiving begins on a houseboat as Keziah suppresses old friction.
Gran calls Ezra to sit beside her and needles Keziah about the turkey.
Gran announces she sold the house and is moving onto the boat.

s00029.summary: Controller Ozzie shows his granddaughter Pru a Cessna on the radar in the tower.
A Cessna requests landing in gusty wind with thirty minutes of fuel.
Ozzie hands Pru the headset and she nervously clears the pilot to land.
They all watch the plane touch down safely.

s00175.summary: Under cover of oiling a clock, thieves plan to drop through the pendulum shaft into a bank vault.
They fix Thursday after the noon chime and the nervous lookout reassures them.

s01505_0.summary: Six strangers sit in a snowed-in hotel lobby, introduced one by one.
A scream from upstairs freezes the lobby; Raymond takes the room key from the clerk.
Raymond bounds up the stairs, followed by Samuel and Callista.

s00433.summary: Francisco and Nina meet over a satchel; Roland emerges from behind a pillar.
Nina lunges for the satchel and they tumble before Roland stops them.
Roland tosses the satchel back and leaves; Francisco finds it empty.

s01156.summary: Iolanthe stares at a sealed parchment before cracking the seal.
A letter in her young voice warns her not to open the third door.
She considers the bell and refuses absolutely to ring it.
The last line asks her to be brave; she rings the bell three times.
The door's nails slide out; she takes a candle and walks toward it.

s01375_0.summary: Old lamplighter Cornelius stalls polishing glass while reporter Tobias presses about the Pettigrew matter.
Tobias raises eleven dark lamps on the night Pettigrew died.
Cornelius admits a man in a good coat paid him forty sovereigns to put out the lamps.
Tobias promises to print it and apologizes; Cornelius wants to finish his round.
Tobias offers to walk with him and they go out into the fog.

s02164.summary: Five friends crowd a karaoke booth, Kira singing badly while others trade glances.
Nola praises Arthur's toast and Kira pushes them to sing the last song.
Hugo announces Arthur proposed to him seven years ago in this same booth.

s01318.summary: A chaotic farmhouse family breakfast runs smoothly through habit and scolding.
Danny teases Rosie's horse drawing while Walt defends the potato.
Walt finally folds his paper and the family laughs at their staring.

s02470.summary: Ingrid and Kofi watch a late gondola climb on the monitor.
Halvorsen radios that Car 7 is parked in the depot; Ingrid has the lights killed.
Bashir enters through the stairwell door and the car brings Lenka.
Bashir locks the door and demands the ledger, citing Ingrid's husband.

s00977.summary: Relatives mock Rosalind's canned-soup casserole at the lighthouse potluck.
Aunt Fenella sweeps in and claims to have invented the casserole in 1974.

s01152.summary: At a harvest dinner Rosa needles Teddy as the family and guests squirm.
Teddy admits he signed the bridge loan on the land for the combine.
Teddy shoves his chair back; Oleksandr silences him and orders him to sit.
Oleksandr says the land was a loan from the weather and fears untruthful tables.
Kieran's fireflies glow when scared, breaking tension; the family laughs and eats together.

s00963.summary: Bramble guides Tilly through a treetop market, waving off Quillon's lucky bones.
Tilly points out a faceless hooded figure staring at them from the bridge.
They bolt as the bridge ropes snap behind them and Bramble swings them to safety.
The figure walks away through the air; Bramble says everything comes back.

s00791.summary: A woman in green enters the ruined ballroom after the wedding.
Catalina records a message to the tape and apologizes for wearing green.
She ignores a ringing phone, leaves the recorder running, and switches off the chandelier.
